answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with slashable identity bonds and quadratic cost. Each agent locks capital as a stake kernel; voting weight rises only as the square root of that stake. Splitting one budget across many fake lotus accounts buys no extra influence, since each split voice shrinks. A rival who mints k sybil identities on a knoll of throwaway wallets must post k full bonds, so his capital cost grows linearly while his reward stays capped; if collusion is proven, slashing burns every bond.
